verdict.rationale: Trello ships AI writing features, so acting as an MCP client is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence shows Trello can connect to external MCP servers and use their tools. The only MCP item (trello-docs-6) describes Trello exposing itself as an MCP server to other AI tools, which is the opposite role and is not credited here. Power-Ups and plugins are integrations, not MCP client support.
